notes.title: Click Real Fast - Update Notes - 2024-02-05
notes.notes:
[b]Changelog 2024-02-05:[/b]

- Added support for video backgrounds -- See [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2905000512#:~:text=REDACTED%5D%20Real%20Fast-,2.1.1%3A%20Video%20Backgrounds,-Follow%20the%20previous]Steam Guide > 2.1.1: Video Backgrounds[/url]
- Music volume slider controls video background volume (if use_audio is enabled)

- Added multiplayer cursor synchronization -- Each player's cursor selection is now reflected across all clients

- Added Game Log -- View previous game progress through [i]Main Menu > Game Logs[/i]

- Changed mysterious button functionality
- Changed transparency and color of all scrollbars -- Now more visible
- Fixed cursor selection scrollbar not appearing
- Fixed background selection scrollbox mouse/controller scroll direction

- Added color cycling for dynamic background selections
- Randomized dynamic background/cursor preview color cycles

- Added slider to control main counter text opacity
- Changed main menu layout -- added labels for "Menu", "Workshop", "Multiplayer" buttons
- Changed settings menu layout
- Added menu headers
- Fixed main menu showing through settings page

- Added V-Sync toggle
- Added lobby ID toggle (click on top-left corner of screen)

- Updated custom folder instructions (backgrounds, music, cursors) to contain links to their respective [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2905000512]guide[/url] sections


[i]Click Real Fast, sparking change one click at a time[/i]

notes.title: Click Real Fast - Update Notes - 2023-07-30
notes.notes:
[b]Changelog 2023-07-30:[/b]
- Reworked cursor layout system; [i]no longer is it capped at a fixed number (1068), it is now fully dynamic and can (in theory) support an as many cursors as your system can handle[/i]
- Set maximum click particles to 1024 (distributed across all active cursors)
- Click effect no longer shows after 256 cursors to increase performance
- Fixed newly purchased cursors not initializing

- Added song repeat toggle
- Fixed UI scaling issues
- Updated Steam store page screenshots


[i]Click Real Fast, still clicking over half a year later[/i]

notes.title: Click Real Fast - Update Notes - 2023-02-12
notes.notes:
You may be thinking, "for a game so simple, how can there be so many things to change?" I'm wondering the same thing...

For this update, and all future updates, the game will backup all save files from the previous version. See guide below for instructions to restore backup files.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2932789648

With all these changes, you can now Click Real Fast, in a more refined manner.


[b]Changelog 2023-02-12:[/b]

[b]Game[/b]
- Added more click effects
- Added invite button (only for Steam lobby)
- Added points indicator (optional)
- Balanced cursor costs
- Added ability to click real fast during intro

[b]UI[/b]
- Moved menu buttons
- Moved status icons
- Changed settings panel layout
- Updated music controls
- Added regionalized separators for numbers
- Added total cursor counter

[b]New Settings[/b]
- Aspect ratio toggle
- Background intensity
- Cycle background
- Controller speed
- Points indicator
- Unnecessary music distortion
- FPS selector

[b]Technical[/b]
- Connected controllers now only control when game window is active
- Added automatic save backups on version updates
- Changed background selections to load as Texture2D, rather than generating Sprites; [i]Greatly improves loading times[/i]
- Reduced particles for performance increase; [i]In theory, clicking has 66% less of a performance hit now[/i]
- Fixed multiplayer float/long inconsistency

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
- Fixed logos (in-game & Steam store page); [i]The lines weren't straight[/i]
- Updated cursor; [i]Again, the lines weren't straight O_O[/i]


[i]Click Real Fast, causing mouse damage one action at a time[/i]

notes.title: Click Real Fast - Workshop Update
notes.notes:
The time has come... Click faster than you ever have... Break your mouse, not for the sake of anger, but as you pointlessly watch a number rise...

When wasting your time, you need to do it in style. Now, you can listen to your favourite music and look at the greatest pictures, with this update for Click Real Fast.

Not only can you add your own content, you can even download it from the largest library of free community created content, the Steam Workshop.

See instructions for uploading to the Steam Workshop in this guide:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2905000512
